column1: # The take-ups a human committed that scripts/lib/take-up-parity.sh replays with nuc upgrade
# (API-upgrade-by-blob-toml-optional), read by scripts/check-parity.sh. One row per take-up, four
# fields separated by tabs: the repository's URL, the commit before the take-up, the commit that
# ends it, each by its 40-hex name, and the URL of the template. The releases are the ones the
# README names at the two commits. This repository's own take-ups, since the derived repositories
# of the corpus are on v0.6.1, before the earliest release nuc upgrade takes up from; a row joins
# for each take-up from v0.9.0 on that a repository commits.
